subject: MAP: acceptance sprint + escrow & retention checks for SummitTrust
messages:
From: Alexis Chen <alexis.chen@summittrust.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@summittrust.com>
Date: 2027-10-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial MAP ask: evidence scope + retention window

Neha — thanks for the demo yesterday. As discussed with Marco and the security team, we want to scope the MAP acceptance sprint so we can sign the DPA and close pilot by the end of November. Two immediate asks: 1) a short list of the SOC 2 artifacts you will provide for evidence review, and 2) your default data retention policy and options for a 90/180/365 day retention window.

High level constraints: SummitTrust requires SOC 2 Type II evidence for the last 12 months, a completed SIG/CAIQ, and a DPA with EU data residency options (we have EU tenants). We're also evaluating an escrow clause for customer-managed KMS keys or an escrowed key-release process in the event of bankruptcy. Can you confirm what Redwood supports today and any additional steps required for escrow?

Thanks — Alexis
Security PM, SummitTrust

--
Attachment: initial-evidence-ask-template.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: Alexis Chen <alexis.chen@summittrust.com>, Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@summittrust.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2027-10-21T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP ask: evidence scope + retention window

Alexis — great to connect. Replicating answers here so the MAP can be updated. Short answers up front, details below:

1) SOC 2 artifacts we will provide during the sprint:
- SOC 2 Type II report (redacted where necessary) covering last 12 months
- SOC 2 controls matrix & mapping to our production clusters
- Evidence index (logs, change records, access review samples) — we will surface these in a shared Drive folder
- Third-party penetration test summary and remediation log

2) SIG/CAIQ: we will provide a completed CAIQ v3 spreadsheet and a narrative for items that map to our hosted/dedicated/private variants. We attach a working draft for your reviewers.

3) DPA and retention: Redwood's default retention for hosted customers is 180 days for request logs (configurable) and 365 days for audit logs. We support configurable retention down to 30 days and up to customer-managed options for Private deployments. For EU data residency we can offer EU-hosted deployment (region lock) for production workloads.

4) Escrow / KMS: We support customer-managed encryption keys via KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault). For escrow, we have two pragmatic options:
- Key escrow via a neutral escrow provider (legal + technical handoff) — needs review by legal; typical timeline 4–6 weeks for paperwork.
- Escrowed release process: we can provide an authenticated key-release protocol in the event of contract termination with conditional legal triggers (requires limited engineering changes if not already using customer-managed keys).

Action items for MAP update:
- Redwood to drop SOC 2 evidence index and CAIQ draft by Friday (I put a Drive link below).
- SummitTrust to confirm preferred retention window (90/180/365) and whether they will pursue KMS escrow or customer-managed KMS.
- Align on DPA redline owner (we expect SummitTrust to propose redlines; Redwood will respond within 3 business days).

I'll attach the current evidence index and CAIQ draft. If helpful, Jonas can run a 30min walkthrough with your security reviewers next week.

Thanks — Neha
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: soc2-evidence-index.pdf; summittrust-sig-caiq-answers-v1.xlsx
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleEvidenceFolder

From: Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@summittrust.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, Alexis Chen <alexis.chen@summittrust.com>
Date: 2027-10-22T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP ask: evidence scope + retention window

On Fri, Oct 21, 2027 at 10:04 AM neha_kapoor@redwood.com wrote:
> Alexis — great to connect. Replicating answers here so the MAP can be updated. Short answers up front, details below:
>
> 1) SOC 2 artifacts we will provide during the sprint:
> - SOC 2 Type II report (redacted where necessary) covering last 12 months
> - SOC 2 controls matrix & mapping to our production clusters
> - Evidence index (logs, change records, access review samples) — we will surface these in a shared Drive folder
> - Third-party penetration test summary and remediation log

Thanks Neha — that list looks good. A couple of clarifying Qs from the SummitTrust security reviewers:
- For the SOC 2 evidence index, can you surface sample AWS CloudTrail screenshots for the last 30 days (access to admin roles) and a redacted user access review showing manager approvals?
- For retention: we are leaning 90 days for request logs, 365 days for audit logs. Can Redwood indicate any pricing delta versus the 180-day default?

Also: escrow — SummitTrust prefers a documented escrow-release process vs full third-party escrow if Redwood can provide an explicit technical handoff plan and a contractual trigger list. Please confirm if Redwood can commit to engineering implementation timelines in the MAP (we need a commit by Nov 5 to remain on our procurement schedule).

Marco
Director, InfoSec Programs, SummitTrust

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@summittrust.com>, Alexis Chen <alexis.chen@summittrust.com>, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2027-10-25T14:16:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP ask: evidence scope + retention window

Hi Marco — thanks, and good clarifications. Quick answers and commitments we can put in the MAP timeline: 

- SOC 2 evidence samples: we will upload CloudTrail snippets and a redacted access-review PDF by Oct 27. These are standard artifacts and already in our evidence index.
- Retention pricing: moving request logs to 90 days vs default 180 days reduces storage and therefore lowers the usage price for logs ~12% on average; moving audit logs to 365 days yields a small incremental charge (~4%). We'll serve an exact delta in the updated MAP cost appendix.
- Escrow-release process: Redwood can document a technical handoff process (key export workflow under legal triggers). Engineering estimate: if we scope as an augmented runbook (no KMS infra changes), we can commit to delivering the runbook + scripted handoff automation by Nov 4. If you require full third-party escrow integration we estimate 4–6 weeks.

Proposed MAP milestones (to include in the mutual action plan):
- Oct 27: SOC 2 sample artifacts uploaded to Drive (evidence folder)
- Oct 29: CAIQ final draft delivery and security walkthrough (30min)
- Nov 4: Escrow-release runbook & scripted handoff (if opting for runbook route)
- Nov 5: SummitTrust DPA redline due (to stay on procurement schedule)
- Nov 12: Final MAP signoff and pilot start (target)

If these dates look good, Neha will update the MAP doc with owners and acceptance criteria. Marcus — can you confirm the acceptance criteria for the escrow runbook (e.g., test export in staging, witness window, legal signoff)?

Thanks — Jonas
VP, Solutions & Security, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: dpa-redline-v3.docx (placeholder)

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@summittrust.com>, Alexis Chen <alexis.chen@summittrust.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2027-10-28T15:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP ask: evidence scope + retention window

Thanks all — summarizing the MAP update (I'll drop an editable MAP in Drive after this email):

Acceptance criteria (security/compliance gates) to be captured in MAP:
- SOC 2: Redacted SOC 2 Type II report + controls matrix + 3 sample evidence artifacts (CloudTrail snippet, access-review PDF, change-ticket log) — security team to confirm evidence sufficiency in 3 business days after upload.
- SIG/CAIQ: Completed CAIQ spreadsheet + written clarifications for items marked 'partial' or 'n/a' — acceptance when SummitTrust security confirms no outstanding P1 clarifications.
- DPA: SummitTrust to submit redlines by Nov 5; Redwood to respond within 3 business days. Final DPA signature is a MAP milestone and required before pilot begin.
- Data retention/residency: SummitTrust to confirm retention windows (we have draft pricing deltas). EU tenancy needs to be specified per workload; Redwood will provide region-lock options for production by Nov 1.
- Escrow: Redwood will produce an escrow-release runbook and automation script by Nov 4 for review. Acceptance requires a successful dry-run in staging (single test export witnessed by SummitTrust) and legal confirmation of trigger list. If SummitTrust prefers third-party escrow, update MAP with 4–6 week integration schedule.

Next steps:
1) Neha to upload MAP + evidence folder (today).
2) SummitTrust to confirm retention choice and DPA redline owner (by Nov 5).
3) Jonas/Marcus to do security walkthrough on Oct 29 (30min) — Neha to schedule.

I'll upload the files and share the DocuSign packet for the DPA once redlines are resolved. Thanks for the quick coordination — we should be able to hit the procurement window if we keep to the dates above.

Best — Neha
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
